items.name: Flask of Crimson Tears
items.japanese_name: 緋雫の聖杯瓶 (Akashizuku no Seihai-bin)
items.effect: Restores HP
items.summary: Flask of Crimson Tears is a refillable tool in Elden Ring.
effect_details: Restores between 250 (at +0) and 810 (at +12) HP when used, expending 1 charge. This also heals Torrent for the same amount.
Maximum charges are replenished after resting at a Sites of Grace.
A charge can be expended to revive Torrent if he is killed.
→ Torrent will be revived with half-health.
Maximum charges can be increased using a Golden Seed at a Site of Grace. The number of seeds needed for each level increases as you progress.
→ The player starts with 4 charges and a maximum of 14 total charges can be held between this flask and the Flask of Cerulean Tears.
→→ The amount of Golden Seeds needed to gain another charge increases for every two charges gained, starting at 1 Seed needed to gain a 5th flask and ending at 5 Seeds needed to gain a 12th flask.
→→ A total amount of 30 Golden Seeds are needed to gain 14 charges. Roughly 47 Golden Seeds can be found throughout the game in a single Journey, well in excess of this amount.
→ Charges can be allocated between this flask and the Flask of Cerulean Tears at a Site of Grace.
The potency of the flask can be permanently increased by +1 (up to +12) by expending Sacred Tears at a Site of Grace.
→ Restores 250 HP at +0, 345 HP at +1, 430 HP at +2, 505 HP at +3, 570 HP at +4, 625 HP at +5, 670 HP at +6, 700 HP at +7, 730 HP at +8, 755 HP at +9, 780 HP at +10, 795 HP at +11, and 810 HP at +12.

→→ The increases are by far the greatest with the first few Sacred Tears. This makes the four Tears acquirable throughout Limgrave (including the Weeping Peninsula) incredibly valuable as they together increase the Flask's healing by 128%.
→ The potency of the flask can be temporarily increased even further by equipping the following items:
→→ Crimson Tear Scarab (+10%)
→→ Guardian Garb (Full Bloom) (+10%)
→→ Crimson Seed Talisman/Crimson Seed Talisman +1 Shadow of the Erdtree (+20%/+30%)
The flask's icon changes as charges are used.
→ When more than 2 thirds of the flask's allocated charges remain, both the main body and throat of the flask icon will glow gold and be filled with red.
→ When between 2 thirds and 1 third of the flask's allocated charges remain, only the main body of the flask icon will glow gold and about half of it will be filled with red.
→ When less than 1 third of the flask's allocated charges remain, only the bottom of the main body of the flask icon will glow gold and only the bottom of it will be filled with red.

details: Automatically acquired after reaching the Stranded Graveyard at the start of the game.

items.japanese_name: 霊薬の聖杯瓶 (Reiyaku no Seihai-bin)
items.effect: Bestows various special effects
items.summary:
Flask of Wondrous Physick is a refillable tool in Elden Ring.

It allows you to combine two Crystal Tears into a potion that can be used once per rest at a site of grace. There are a total of 32 Crystal Tears in the game, with 3 of those being duplicates.
items.description:
A relic of the physick chemists, priests of the Erdtree. Harnesses the powers of crystal tears, which only form after the passage of many moons.

Various special effects are bestowed upon the drinker, dependent on the specific mixture of crystal tears. Rest at a site of grace to replenish.

Basins are placed at the feet of Minor Erdtrees throughout the Lands Between in order to collect their crystallized tears.
effect_details: Up to two Crystal Tears can be added to the Flask of Wondrous Physick at a Site of Grace. Using the flask will allow the player to benefit from the effects specified by the used Crystal Tears.
It has a single charge, which is replenished after resting at a Site of Grace.

details: Found in a basin in the Third Church of Marika, together with one of the two Crimson Crystal Tears.
If it hasn't been acquired before defeating two Shardbearers it can instead be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 500 Runes.

items.name: Lulling Branch
items.effect: Restores FP while slowly building up Sleep onto oneself.
items.summary: Lulling Branch is a consumable tool in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Tree branch blessed with a velvety purple incantation. Craftable item.

Pierce oneself, causing a gentle buildup of sleep. FP gradually recovers during this time.

When this sleep reaches the threshold of causing temporary fogginess, no FP loss is incurred.

In the midst of drowsiness, there is the will to awaken. Feelings that rise from the depths of one's heart.
effect_details: Lulling Branches restore 150 FP over the course of one minute, with 5 being restored every 2 seconds; while FP is being restored however, the player is inflicted with 20 points of Sleep build-up every two seconds, accumulating in approximately 315 Sleep build-up when accounting for the decay build-up between ticks. If the player is inflicted with Sleep via the Lulling Branch, they will not lose any FP.

details: Crafted with St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3].

notes: Stimulating Boluses can be used to fight off the Sleep build-up.
Lulling Branches can be used to trigger St. Trina's Smile, as the talisman will still grant the buff even the sleep was self-inflicted like the other exultation talismans.

items.summary: Spellproof Dried Liver is a craftable, consumable in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a blue medicinal
solution. Craftable item.

Temporarily boosts magic damage negation, improving
damage mitigation against attacks imbued with magic.
effect_details: Increases Magic damage negation by +15% (+10% in PvP) for 120 seconds upon consumption. This counts as a Body Buff.

details: Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11] from the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) who sits at the southern end of Lake of Liurnia's great lake, near the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace. Costs 1,500 Runes.

Found next to a large tombstone near a plank bridge during the outside section with Putrid Corpses at the Academy of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: Compared to Magic Fortification:

→ In PvE there is a tradeoff, the Liver has greater duration (120 seconds vs 90 seconds) and much lower FP cost (0 FP versus 20 FP) while the Fortification has greater Magic damage negation (35% versus 15%).
→ In PvP the Liver is stronger, since these effects have the same strength but the Liver has a greater duration and no FP cost.

items.description:
Cured animal liver, dried out after pickling in a golden

effect_details: Increases Holy damage negation by 35% (10% in PvP) upon consumption. This counts as a Body Buff.

details: Can be crafted after acquiring the Missionary's Cookbook 6 from a cell in the bottom of dark tower in Volcano Manor. The tower is found beside the lava lake after the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, and is entered through an open window before descending further down through ladders and stairs.

Found in a dark sewer room under the wing of the great dragon Gransax's corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital. The area is guarded by a Broken Gargoyle Statue in an opening and also contains one Erdsteel Dagger.

notes: Unlike the other Liver items, the Holyproof Dried Liver has a much stronger effect that is on par with the associated elemental fortification Incantation instead of weaker than it.

This means that it is almost strictly superior to Divine Fortification in both PvE and PvP due to having the same effectiveness, greater duration (120 seconds vs 90 seconds), much lower FP cost (0 FP vs 20 FP). The only downside is that Divine Fortification can be used infinitely after acquiring it as long as you have a Sacred Seal and 10 Faith while the Liver has to be repeatedly crafted for that, which may require you to run out of the way to grab crafting materials.

items.summary: Rock Heart is a tool in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Heart consumed in the ancient, original form of Dragon Communion. Use while disrobed to turn one's human flesh into an ancient dragon.

The change cannot be undone except by death. Using this heart while already transformed temporarily boosts Dragon Communion incantations.

The last thing the partaker saw with human eyes was a sunset, its colors faded and tarnished—a remote thing from eternity.
effect_details: The Rock Heart transforms the player into a humanoid dragon. The player must unequip all their armor in order for the item to be usable, and upon death the player will return to their normal form. In order to compensate for the player not being able to wear armor, being in dragon from grants a passive +50 boost to Immunity, Robustness, Focus and Vitality, as well as a flat 10% damage reduction to all types of damage; Poise is not granted.

Using the Rock Heart again while in dragon form will grant a Unique Buff that increases the damage of all Dragon Communion Incantations by +20% for 60 seconds. As it's a Unique Buff it doesn't conflict with other buffs, like Flame, Grant Me Strength or Golden Vow.

details: After finding the "Domain of Dragons" Painting, start at the Jagged Peak Mountainside Site of Grace and head up the mountain to a Spiritspring. Drop down to the right at the end of the long ledge and then drop down to the right again, then go down two small ledges to find the painter with the Heart.

→ To find the painting, head northwest at the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace in Shadow Keep and proceed up the stairs to a Black Knight and some burning boats. Find the ladder in the far left corner of the boat area, then go through the waterfall to the right at the bottom of the ladder to find another one. Take a right at the bottom and go through an illusory wall to find the painting.

notes: The Dragon Communion Seal stacks with the Rock Heart buff.

Taunter's Tongue is a reusable tool in Elden Ring. It allows you to be invaded by players at any time, instead of only when a Furled Finger player has been summoned.

It also increases the limit of invaders to two, but a co-operator must be present before a second player can invade. Additionally, it decreases the amount of time between possible invasions.

A Furlcalling Finger Remedy must be used for invasions to happen.
items.description:
Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Multiplayer menu.)

Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion.

Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader to join when a cooperator is present. (With two invaders, the maximum number of cooperators becomes one.)

details: Received after defeating the invader Mad Tongue Alberich in the hall of the Roundtable Hold, accessed by jumping off the balcony.
